#### Corporate Governance

In 2015, the bank strictly observed the "company law", "commercial bank law" and other relevant laws and regulations, in combination with the practical situation of the bank, continually perfected the corporate governance structure, gave full play to the role of the "three boards and one executive". The corporate governance level was continued to improve.

## I Shareholders and the Shareholders Meeting

At the end of the report period, the total number of the Bank's shareholders is 179, of which there are 79 legal person shareholders and 100 natural person shareholders. During the report period, the Bank held the annual general meeting for twice, Passed 12 important proposals. The meeting notice, convene, holding and voting procedures strictly complied with the company law, the articles of association of Longjiang Bank co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the "articles of association of the bank") and the rules of procedure of the shareholders general meeting of Longjiang Bank co., Ltd., related regulation, to ensure that all the shareholders, especially minority shareholders to exercise the due right to know, participation and vote right. Beijing Junzejun Law Firm was presenting at the site to witness two general shareholder meetings and provided the legal opinion. The details are as follows:

On March 21, 2015, the first extraordinary shareholder general meeting of the bank was held at the four floor conference room of Longjiang Bank head office, No. 436, Youyi Road, Daoli District with live holding. The written notice of this meeting was issued March 5, 2015 to all the shareholders. There were total 103 shareholders directly attending or entrusting the agent to attend the meeting. The number of the voting share of the representatives was 3.73 billion shares. The total sum of shares which reached the voting right of the bank was 85.6% of 4.36 billion shares. Through the shareholder deliberation and voting, the deliberation has passed the two proposals of "proposal on the adjustment of the Content modification of the articles of association of Longjiang Bank Co., Ltd.", and the "proposal on electing Mr. Lu Yujie as the second director of the board of directors of Longjiang Bank".

On June 30, 2015, the 2014 annual general shareholder meeting of the bank was held at the four floor conference room of Longjiang Bank head office, No.436, Youyi Road, Daoli District, Harbin with live holding. The written notice of this meeting was issued on June 10, 2015 to all the shareholders. There were total 102 shareholders directly attending or entrusting the agent to attend. The number of the voting share of the representatives was 3.64 billion shares. The total sum of shares which reached the voting right of the bank was 83.4% of 4.36 billion shares. Through the shareholder deliberation and voting, the deliberation has passed the "proposal on Longjiang Bank board. The number of the share number of the representatives who had right to vote was 3.64 billion shares. The total sum of shares which reached the voting right of the bank was

83.4% of 4.36 billion shares. Through the shareholder deliberation and voting, the deliberation has passed the "proposal on Longjiang Bank board director 2014 annual work report" and the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank board supervisor annual work report", and "the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank annual financial final cost scheme", and the "proposal on Longjiang Bank 2014 annual profit distribution plans", and the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank Co., Ltd. annual report". The "Proposal on 2015 Longjiang Bank annual financial budge", and the "proposal on loan deductions and exemptions authority", and the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank director performance situation assessment report" and the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank supervisor performance situation assessment report" and the "proposal on 2014 Longjiang Bank annual executive layer and its member performance situation assessment report" and other 10 item proposals.

## II Directors, Board of Directors and Special Committee

(I) Directors. At the end of report period, the bank's Board of Directors is composed of 12 directors, of which 3 directors are independent directors. All the directors have work experience in economy, finance, financing and accounting and other relevant fields, as well as rich experience in management.

(II) Special Committee. The bank establishes four special committees: Strategic Planning (6S) Committee, Risk Management and Related Transactions Control Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Audit Committee, and each committee has clear right and responsibility and clear division of labor. Except that the Chairman of Strategic Planning (6S) Committee is held by directors, the Chairmans of other special committees are held by independent directors.

## III Supervisor, Board of Supervisors and Special Committee

(I) Supervisors. At the end of report period, the bank's Board of Supervisors is composed of 6 supervisors, of which there are 2 Shareholder Supervisors, 2 Worker Supervisors and 2 External Supervisors; it conforms to relevant laws and regulations and provisions of the Bank's Charter.

(II) Special Committee. According to supervising and managing requirements and provisions of the bank's charter, under the e Board of Supervisors, the Audit Committee and Nominations Committee are set, and the post of two professional committees are held by external supervisors.

## IV Assessment, Incentive and Constraint Mechanisms for Senior Management

The bank adheres to the principle of unifying the incentive and constraint, and the senior management has clear assignment of responsibility and clear performance target. During the reporting period, the second session of the board of directors of the 15 times meeting of the bank set for index and target value of the 2015 annual performance appraisal to the management level. At the same time, on the basis of the second session of 17 times meeting, it examined and approved the proposal on settlement scheme of 2014 senior management remuneration of the bank, completed 2014 annual salary liquidation of the bank executives.

## Work Statement of Longjiang Bank Board of Directors in 2015

It is a key year for the acceleration of transformation development and achievement of a new undertaking of Longjiang Bank in 2015. In the circumstance that domestic economy is growingly slowing and horizontal competition is increasingly furious, the board of directors follows close to the line of national policies and legislations and various supervision requirements, earnestly performs the duties, initiatives, grasps development opportunity in new tendency, innovates while reforms and develops while innovates, strictly controls risks, accelerates the fulfillment of strategy, and achieves a goof performance. After audit in 2015, the bank took net profits of 1.143 billion yuan (the standard of parent company, similarly hereinafter); return on assets is 0.65%; capital return is 9.49%; total assets are 212.618 billion yuan; outstanding of deposits is 128.105 billion yuan; balance of various loans is 62.061 billion yuan, and it is controlled within the credit scale approved by People's Bank of China; non-performing loan ratio is 2.53%; capital adequacy ratio is 11.59%. main supervision indexes reach the standard totally. Main conditions of board of directors in 2015 are stated as follows:

## I Quicken transformation development, deepen strategy implementation

(I) Accelerate strategy fulfillment steadily. The board of directors sticks to the market positioning of "facing agricultural industry, facing middle and small-sized enterprises and facing local economy", and accelerates strategy fulfillment steadily in 2015.

Firstly, spare no efforts to push business development about agriculture, farmer and rural area. In 2015, in accordance with the requirements in the period of transformation development, the bank work determines the thinking about agriculture, farmer and rural area of tamping basis, promoting development, adjusting structure and controlling risks", spares no efforts to push business development, actively provides financial support for the agricultural industry construction. In 2015, loans involved in agriculture accumulated to 10.17 billion yuan. The held rural banks develop steadily; total assets are 4.29 billion yuan; owner's equity is 0.58 billion yuan; balance of various loans is 2.89 billion yuan; loan balance is 2.44 billion yuan and profits are 47 million yuan.

Secondly, continuously improve micro financial service. The bank emphasizes on the point of "consolidating brand, tamping foundation, improving quality and operating in line with regulations, continues micro financial business in further, optimizes product system and accelerates mobile marketing system development and other work by adjusting business structure of micro financial business; moreover, the bank actively accelerates the transformation of micro financial business, effectively supports "mass startup and innovation". In 2015, the loan of small enterprises stimulated is 7.8 billion yuan, and the quantity of served customer is more than 97,000.

Thirdly, continuously reinforce the construction of community bank. The bank accelerates the transformation of community banks, improves individual financial service level, completes wealth management system, explores innovation in business model, actively builds convenient community banks for financial management, and enhances the market competitiveness of community banks in further. By the end of 2015, the balance of saving deposits is 51.673 billion yuan per day, increasing by 8.775 billion yuan compared with the previous year; and time-point balance is 56.872 billion yuan, increasing 11.884 billion yuan compared with the previous year.

(II) Make great efforts to boost transformation and seek for innovative development. In the circumstance of rapid development of internet finance and narrow of bank profits space, the board of directors of the bank actively makes decisions, explores the transformation development with an open visual angle and spares no efforts to create new growth point of profits.

Firstly, accelerate the improvement of internet financial development. The bank takes finance as an important direction of strategy transformation, carries out preferential policy on fields of personnel, capitals and system development, etc., pushes the leapfrog development of internet finance, launches exclusive financial products on internet such as "Qianlaifeng", "Jingdong money", "on-line pledge and loan" and the like; in addition, payment via alipay, tenpay, WeChat, Jingdong payment emerges. Mobile banking financial service functions are rich and colorful and considerable development is achieved in internet financial business. The yearly transaction amount on mobile banking reaches up to 37.13 billion yuan and the transaction amount in digital channel reached up to 219 billion yuan, with an increase range of 10.45%.

Secondly, actively broaden financial market business. In the premise of accurately seizing market opportunity,

meeting laws and regulations and that risks can be controlled, the bank continuously broadens low-risk financial market business and gains a favorable effect. The yearly capital business is 4.07 billion yuan, accounting for 46.42% of operation revenue of the bank.

Thirdly, accelerate network construction and transformation. With the emerging of internet finance, the bank abandons the traditional thinking of "large and comprehensive" and "full coverage", makes great efforts to push network construction and transformation, plans and arranges prudently, enhances evaluation management, and ensures that the network construction is scientific and effective.

## II Effectively deliberate various proposals and improve operation efficiency of the board of directors

In 2015, in accordance with the constitution and relevant rules of procedure and actual work requirements, the bank regularly holds board meeting and working conferences of various special committees, timely researches on major matters, which guarantees the effectiveness of policies and operation regulation. Total 7 board meetings are held yearly, 20 items of proposals such as financial budget program in 2015 are reached and deliberated, 11 business reports are listened, which improves the effectiveness of board meeting in further and effectively give play to scientific decision-making and strategic management. Each special committees of the board of directors performs its own functions, emphasizes on management examination, risk management, financial management and other key work, and provides strongly support for the scientific decisions of the board of directors. Totally 12 special committee meetings are organized and held yearly, including: 2 committee meetings of strategic planning (6S), 2 committee meetings of nomination and payment, 4 committee meetings of risk management connected transaction and control, 4 meetings of audit committee; moreover, 20 items of proposals were deliberated and 7 items of reports were listened.

## III Strengthen the construction of corporate governance, and enhance the ability of corporate governance

(I) Improve organizational structure. The board deliberation of the bank adopt "About a Bill to Adjust the Internal Institutions of the Head Office of Longjiang Bank" and optimize adjustment to the internal institutions of the head office according to the needs of the business development in 2015. The addition of rural banking management department under the board of directors, and the addition of risk assets

management department and financial management division under the management further impel the development of transformation and promote the operation and management ability.

(II) Strengthen salary administration. The board consideration of the bank adopt "2014 Annual Senior Executives Compensation Solution of LJBC" and do annual performance appraisal to senior executives of the head office according to the relevant provisions of the bank in 2015.

(III) Standardize the connected transactions. To standardize the management of the connected transactions and control the risk of the connected transactions in strict accordance with "Regulations for the Management of the Connected Transactions of LJBC". There are no cases to damage the interests of the bank and the minority shareholders because the behaviors of the connected transactions all year around are in accordance with the law compliance.

(IV) Carefully carry out equity management. To standardize the equity transfer, pledge and other behaviors, which protect the legitimate rights and interests of all shareholders in strict accordance with "Measures for the Implementation of Equity Management of LJBC".

(V) Each bill is in implement. To grasp the implementation of each bill earnestly, urge strictly the management level to intensify the execution of the bill, listen to the feedback regularly and strengthen the supervision and management of the bill, which protect the items of the general meeting of stockholders and the decision-making of board to effectively apply.

## IV Strengthen the construction of internal control, and punning the foundation of risk control

The board of directors of the bank specially hold four working conferences for the risk management of board of directors and the connected transaction and control committee, listen to the detailed reports about all kinds of risks of the bank, enhance the forward guidance and supervision and evaluation to risk, and punning the foundation of risk control constantly by strictly implementation of each supervision requirement and adhering to be prudent to the principle of compliance management in 2015.

Firstly, change the concept of development, and strengthen the bottom-line thinking. Pay attention to the prospective study of economical situation, and emphasize on the realization of sustainable development under the controllable risks; strengthen the accountability, enhance the consciousness of the red line, and

adhere to the laws to be followed and the violation of laws to be punished. Secondly, unify the risk appetite, and intensify the risk management. To implement the dynamic management of authorization and make a unified management to credit risk through the lateral and longitudinal concentration; reinforce the collect disposal to non-performing loan, realize the "Double Down" of non-performing loan so as to efficiently promote the quality of credit assets. To intensify the market, operation, science and technology and reputation and other risk managements, strengthen the emergency control measures, the compliance of internal control and other works, and reinforce the management to bonding companies, regulation companies and other third-party partners. Thirdly, eliminate the potential risks by reinforcing the interim monitoring to the key aspects of post competitive, tendering procurement and other major events, carrying out "Two Reinforcements and Two Restraints", "Reviews" and other special examinations in a deep-going way, and carrying through special audit to non-standard creditor's rights, village and town bank credit and so on.

## V Directors are loyal industrious, and perform duties earnestly

All the directors of the bank, with resumption and due diligence according to the laws, are present meetings of board of directors and each special committee earnestly, take an active part in the research, discussion and decision-making to the deliberation matters, listen to the reports of management level at fixed period, understand the overall situation of the operation management, come up with precious comments and suggestions to boost the strategy transformation development of the bank, reinforce the overall risk management, improve the capacity of corporate governance and other major works, which embody a high sense of responsibility and a good professional accomplishment and maintain the interests of the bank and all shareholders practically in strict accordance with the connected laws and regulations and the requirement of the articles of association of the bank in 2015. The independent directors of the bank can give full play to their own specialty, perform duties independently and fairly, and maintain the interests of the depositors, minority shareholders and the bank according to the requirement of regulations and articles of association of the bank.

## Work Statement of Longjiang Bank Board of Supervisors in 2015

In 2015, the board of supervisors earnestly performs the function of supervision and well completes various works yearly under the support and cooperation of the board of directors and management level. Now the relevant situations are reported as below:

## I Working condition of the board of supervisors

(I) Convening situation of the board of supervisors and special committees

The bank has held 3 working conferences of the board of supervisors and examines 11 items of proposals in total all year around, which completes the work plan of the board of supervisors in 2015. All the supervisors can be present at the meetings according to the system demands of the bank. "About the Proposal of Work Plan of the Board of Supervisors in 2015" and "About the Appraisal Report of Resumption Situation of Longjiang Bank Supervisors in 2014" are passed at the first meeting at the beginning of the year, the annual job objective and direction of the board of supervisors is determined and meanwhile summary to the previous year's resumption situation of supervisors is made; the reporting matters are examined and passed at the second meeting, which shall be reported on the annual general meeting of stockholders by the board of supervisors. The reporting matters include the appraisal reports of resumption of directors and senior executives in 2014 and the work statements of board of supervisors. At the same time, the board of supervisors issues independent opinions to the annual audit report and profit-sharing plans of the bank according to the requirement of the articles of association; the revised proposal of 4 items of internal institutions of the board of supervisors is examined and passed at the third meeting, which further optimizes the monitoring program.

The audit committee of the board of supervisors has held 3 working conferences in total all year around, and the nominating committee has held 1 working conference in total all year around. The audit report and profit-sharing plans of the bank in 2014, appraisal reports of resumption of directors, supervisors and senior executives, and 8 proposals of auditing for quitting of senior executives in total are examined and approved by the committee members who promote the bank to complete the corporate governance and realize healthy development by playing a professional competence, actively offering advice and suggestions in the supervision of the management of the bank at the same time.

##### (II) Attending situation of the general meeting of stockholders and board of directors

The supervisors attend 7 board of directors, annual general meeting of stockholders in 2014 and the first extraordinary shareholders meeting in 2015 all year around through on-site and off-site supervision modes, checking and approving 20 items of proposals. The supervisors conduct a supervision to the convening program of the meetings and the legal compliance of the decisions that are made, and propose feasible comments and suggestions to investment and management projects of the bank at the meeting.

The worker supervisors and office workers of board of supervisors attend 36 office meetings of chairman of the board and take part in 191 items of proposals on discussion of research and supervision in total in 2015.

(III) Accomplish the appraisal situation of the resumption of directors, supervisors and senior executives

On the basis of the self-assessment, mutual evaluation of the directors and appraisal to the directors made by the board of supervisors, combining with the materials collected by the office of the board of supervisors, and making assessment and objective evaluation to the resumption situation of the directors, the board of supervisors form the appraisal report to resumption situation of the directors by the board of supervisors in 2014. The appraisal results of resumption of 12 directors who are on the job are competent through the deliberation of the board of supervisors.

Combining with the debriefings of senior executives, mutual evaluation and democratic appraisal situation on the basis of the daily resumption supervision, and making assessment to the resumption situation of the senior executives earnestly, the board of supervisors form the appraisal report to resumption situation of the senior executives in 2014. The appraisal results of 6 senior executives are competent through the deliberation of the board of supervisors.

Peer-reviewed by nominating committee, combining with the situation of participation and resumption of the supervisors, the appraisal report to resumption situation of the supervisors in 2014 is formed and examined and passed by the board of supervisors.

##### (IV) Auditing for quitting of senior executives

The audit team, formed together by the board of supervisors and audit department of board of directors, makes auditing for quitting to 2 senior executives, such as Yu Liyong and Xu Zhihui, makes economic responsibility audit to Li Ruiwen, majored in the situation of comprehensive operation management, the situation of internal controls, the situation of risk management, the ability of sustainable development, honesty

report and the compliance and regulations of independent, and peer-reviews the financial responsibility of various works that are charged by the auditees during his/her tenure of office.

##### (V) Strategic supervision

Each member of the board of supervisors attends the office meetings of chairman of the board and various meetings, studies the conference materials carefully, listens to the report of discussion and the speak of the participants, and monitors the senior management of the bank to efficiently execute the decisions of general meeting of stockholders and board of directors so as to ensure the strategy of the bank can efficiently be fulfilled.

##### (VI) Financial supervision

The board of supervisors mainly adopts the following modes of financial supervision in 2015:

1. The members of the board of supervisors check and approve the financial budget and big amount items of expenditure of the bank to monitor the fiscal expenditure of the bank through attending the financial audit conference. The members of the board of supervisors attend 7 financial audit conferences and 144 items of proposals by deliberation supervision in total in 2015.

2. Because of a big amount of the biding projects of the bank in 2015, the board of supervisors and the disciplinary inspection monitor chamber unite and strengthen the monitoring strength to tendering procurement and ensure the fairness and transparency of the invitation of tender in accordance with the laws compliance through monitoring the experts of personnel selection and monitoring the bid opening meeting all the way. There are 51 items of invitation of tender in total yearly in 2015, and 39 items of which are participated in supervision by the office members of the board of supervisors.

3. The board of supervisors studies and examines carefully the annual audit report in 2014 and profit-sharing plans of the bank, and issues independently the opinion of the board of supervisors.

##### (VII) Risk supervision

The members of the board of supervisors conduct supervision to the risk by attending the credit audit conferences of head office and hearing the report of risk situation of the whole bank.

1. The members of the board of supervisors attend the credit audit conferences of head office, master the flow trend to the large loans and problem loans, the comprehensive credit line situation to group enterprises and the granting situation to affiliated enterprises of the bank, discover some existing problems of the rural banks and put forward rectification suggestions to the problems through a field research.

2. The board of supervisors assists the survey of regulators, makes a rapid and accurate reply to the problems and requirements suggested by regulators, and organizes and practices in time to the rectification requirement and accomplish in supervision.

#### (VIII) Primary research

1. In March 2015, the members of the board of supervisors made a research to 5 rural banks including Dongning Runsheng, Anhui Lingbi Benfu, etc., submitted "the Office of the Board of Supervisors About the Research Reports of Management Situation of Part of the Rural Banks", in which set out four big 13 items of problems discovered in the research, and put forward 18 items of suggestions to the corporate governance, business development, risk management, people management of the rural banks, etc., so as to offer advice and suggestions to the management of the rural banks.

2. In July 2015, the board of supervisors made a research to great Daxing'anling branch, Yichun branch and Jixi branch, submitted "the Board of Supervisors About the Research Report of Management Situation of Part of Branches", conducted survey to the schedule attainment on the first half year of 3 branches, and put forward the resolving suggestion and urged to rectification to the deficiency existing in the working. The board of supervisors put forward suggestions to the senior management of head office on the problems which the branch itself cannot resolve and the common problems discovered in the research.

## II. Independent opinion on relevant matters by the board of supervisors (I) Business condition

By the end of 2015, the total assets of the bank is 212.618 billion yuan with a year-on-year growth of 52.86%; the total deposit balance is 128.105 billion yuan with a year-on-year growth of 12.59%; the total loan balance is 62.061 billion yuan, which increases by 8.356 billion yuan compared with the amount at the beginning of the year; the non-performing loan balance is 1.569 billion yuan with the non-performing loan ratio of 2.53%; the net profit of 1.143 billion yuan is come true with a year-on-year growth of 41.99%.

Worked together with senior management, the board of supervisors fully completes the indexes of annual budget and acquires good results on assets size growth and non-performing loan management in 2015. There are no cases to violate the laws, regulations, articles of association of the bank and damage the interests of the shareholders and the bank on the resumption of the members of the board of supervisors and the senior management in various works of 2015.

#### (II) Financial position

The annual financial report of the bank in 2015 is audited by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Certified Public Accountants on the basis of domestic auditing standards with an issue of standard audit report without reservations. After review the board of supervisors considers that the audit report reflects the financial condition and operating results of the bank in 2015 with reality, impersonality and fairness.

#### (III) Major transaction in assets of the company

In 2015, the amount of fixed assets of the bank that plans to input is 130.81 million yuan, but the actual input is 22.52 million yuan with a planning implementation rate of 17% due to various reasons, such as the construction of the planning branches is not on schedule. The board of supervisors considers that there are no behaviors of insider transactions, no behaviors to damage the interests of the stockholders or give rise to the loss of the assets of the bank in the major transaction in assets during the reporting period.

#### (IV) Connected transaction

The connected transaction of the bank mainly involves in bank deposit and loan transaction. The board of supervisors considers that the bank can conduct connected transaction on the basis of "Regulations of Connected Transaction of Longjiang Bank", the result of which is fair and just, and there are no cases of insider transactions and no cases to damage the interests of the stockholders and the bank during the reporting period.

#### (V) Risk management and internal controls

In 2015, the bank continues to reinforce the construction of risk management system, increase the accountability and inspection, and strengthen the bottom-line thinking and compliance awareness; the bank formulates and completes the emergency plan against reputation risk and liquidity risk. On the problems of increasing sharply of the non-performing loan in banking incurred by the economic downturn, the bank abides by the bottom line of the risk, is strict to the new credit, aggressive investigates the new methods to the disposition of non-performing loan clearance, and realizes "Double Down" of the non-performing loan by multi-policies implementation and corresponding tactics.

#### (VI) Execution of the resolutions of shareholders' meeting

In 2015, the members of the board of supervisors attend the general meeting of stockholders with no objection to all the proposals for deliberation on the general meeting of stockholders according to the law. The board of supervisors considers that the board of directors and senior management earnestly implement the resolutions of shareholders' meeting by the supervision of the implementation of the relevant resolution on this year's general meeting of stockholders.

### Memorabilia During the Reporting Period

1. From January 20 to March 1, the bank successively got the membership qualification of 2015 annual underwriting group of financial bond of Export-Import Bank of China, Agricultural Development Bank of China, China Development Bank.

2. On March 25, the bank launched the first children type balance value-added product "Qianlaifeng" in Heilongjiang province

3. On March 27, the bank "Longyidai - inexpensive series products" won the China banking association "2014 small micro enterprise top twenty financial service product" title.

4. On April 29, Harbin Yingbin branch, Qiqihar branch sales department of the bank and other 12 banks unit was awarded the 2013–2014 provincial "youth civilization" title.

5.On August 5, the bank became the member of the financial cooperation sub-committee of China-Russia prime ministers regular meeting committee, and attended the sixteenth meeting of the financial cooperation sub-committee of China-Russia prime ministers regular meeting committee held in St Petersburg, Russia

6. On October 13, the bank was successfully undertaking the regional financial cooperation seminar of China and Russia. Hao Huilong, the executive vice governor of Heilongjiang province government, and Deng Xianhong, the vice director of state administration of foreign exchange attended the meeting. More than two hundred guests from the financial circle of China and Russia together discussed the related issues of the regional economic and financial cooperation.

7. On December 24, the international business of the bank was awarded A class appraisal by Heilongjiang Province administration of foreign exchange.

8.In December, the mobile banking of the bank won the optimal experience award of regional commercial bank issued by CFCA.

9.In 2015, The Mudanjiang branch sales department, Jiamusi branch sales department, Harbin Wuchang branch, Suihua Huanghe road branch of the bank won the honorary title of "China banking civilization standard five-star service branch"; Qiqihar branch sales department, Qitaihe Boli branch won the honorary title of "China banking civilization standard four-star service branch"; Jixi branch sales department, Heihe Beian branch won the honorary title of "China banking civilizations standard three-star service branch".

10. In 2015, the bank was awarded the title of "excellent enterprise credit reporting system Work outstanding organization" title successively for four years

# Audit Report

DeShijingBao (Audit)Zi(16) No. P1274

##### To: All shareholders of LONGJIANG BANK CORPORATION:

We have audited the accompanying Financial Statements of LONGJIANG BANK CORPORATION. (hereinafter referred to as "Longjiang Bank"), including the Bank and Consolidated Balance Sheet of Dec.31, 2015, Bank and Consolidated Profit Statement of 2015, Consolidated Cash Flow Statement, Statement of Changes in Stockholders' Equity, Bank and Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow and the Notes to Financial Statements.

I. Responsibilities of the Management for Financial Statements

It is the management of Longjiang Bank to be responsible for the preparation and fair presentation of the financial statements. Such responsibility covers: (1) Prepare financial statement in accordance with the Accounting Standards for Enterprises, rendering it with fair reflections; (2) Design, implement and maintain internal control relating to the preparation of financial statements so as to avoid any major misstatement caused by malpractices or mistakes.

II. Responsibilities of (Certified Public Accountant) CPA

It is our responsibility to give auditing opinions to the financial statements based on the implementation of auditing works. We have exercised our auditing works in accordance with the Auditing Standards for CPA which requires us to abide by the professional code of ethics in planning for and implement auditing works and acquire reasonable assurance as to the non-existence of misstatement in financial statements.

Auditing works involve the implementation of audit procedures for acquiring auditing evidence in respect of the amounts and disclosures contained in the financial statements. The audit procedures shall be chosen according to the judgment of CPA, including the assessment of risks of major misstatement in financial statements caused by malpractice or mistakes. In the course of risk assessment, the certified public accountant shall consider the internal control related to the preparing financial statements and fair Presentation financial statements, to design the appropriate audit procedures, but the purpose of it is not to comment on the effectiveness of internal control. The audit work also includes the appropriateness of accounting policies and the rationality of the accounting estimates which is selected and made by the evaluation management level, as well as Overall presentation of evaluating the financial statements.

We believe the audit evidence so acquired by us is sufficient and appropriate, which underlies the publication of audit opinions.

III. Audit Opinions

We have been reassured that the financial statements of Longjiang Bank have been prepared according to the Accounting Standards for Enterprises and have fairly reflected in all major aspects the Bank and Consolidated financial situations of Longjiang Bank by December 31, 2015 and its business performance and cash flow in 2015.
