5. Market Risk

Market risk refers to the risk of losses in the Group's the on-balance and off-balance sheet business due to disadvantageous change of market rate and exchange rate price.

The Group's overall market risk response policies and measures shall be approved by risk management control committee under the Bank's board of directors. Financial market department is responsible for monitoring the Group's market risk and reporting to senior management at regular intervals.

### (1) Exchange rate risk

Foreign exchange rate risk is the risk of loss suffered by the Group due to foreign currency exposures caused by changes in foreign currency exchange rates.

The Group mainly handles RMB transactions, foreign currency transaction is less, and foreign exchange exposure is less, therefore, the Group think that our exchange rate risk is not serious.

### (2) Interest rate risk

The Group's interest rate risk roots mismatching of contract due date and re-pricing date between interest-bearing assets and interest-paid liabilities. the Group monitors regularly re-pricing deadline gap of rate sensitive assets and liabilities by making use of gap analysis system so as to initially adjust proportion of floating interest rate and fixed rate assets, and to control interest rate risk.

Interest-bearing assets and interest-paid liabilities of the Group are mainly valued in RMB. The RMB benchmark interest rate issued by People's Bank of China stipulates the upper limit of RMB deposit interest rates, while the lower limits of RMB loan interest rate are autonomously confirmed by financing institutions according to business principles.

Sensitivity analysis on net interest income bases on one-year influence under the assumption that structure of financial assets and financial liabilities held by each end of report period remain unchanged.

Influence on other consolidated income refers to the influence of fair value change after revaluating fixed rate financial assets available for sale held by the end of report period based on some interest rate change.

The rate of interest of the above forecasted and assumed assets and liabilities in the various time limits (except the current deposit) was moved up or down simultaneously, therefore, it doesn't reflect the influences that may be brought by some interest rates changed but the rest interest rates unchanged. This forecast is based on other simplified assumptions as well, including that all the cash position will be hold until to the maturity. The Group expects that the amount of the sensitivity analysis will not be changed greatly under the circumstance of the cash position is not held to maturity.

The Group considered that this hypothesis did not consider the capital usage situation of the Group and available interest rate risk management policy; therefore, above-mentioned effects may be different from the actual situation.

In addition, above-mentioned interest rate change influence analysis, as cases in point only, shows the estimated change of interest net income and other consolidated income under situation of various predicted income and the Group current interest rate risk. However, this influence hasn't considered the risk management activities that management layer may adopt for reducing interest rate risk.

## 6. Capital Management

The goals of capital management of the Group are as follows:

● Conform to the requirement of the banking market capital supervision in the area of the Group.

● To ensure the ability of continuous operation of the Group to maintain continuous return to shareholders and other parties interested.

● Maintain the sufficient capital support needed for the operation and development.

From 2013, this Group will calculate capital adequacy ratio according to Administrative Measures for the Capital of Commercial Banks (for Trial Implementation) issued by CBRC (China Banking Regulatory Commission). Credit risk adopts method of weighting, market risk adopts standard method, and operation risk will be calculated by basic index method.

The capital compositions of the Group are as follow:

Core tier one capital: Capital stock, capital reserves, surplus public accumulation, general risk preparation, undistributed profit and the minority shareholders' capital which can be included;

Other first class capitals: The minority shareholders' capital which can be included a part;

Tier two capitals: Tier two capitals instrument and premium, excess loan loss preparation and the minority shareholders' capital which can be included a part;

Net capitals shall be calculated at deducting capital deduction items from capitals at all levels according to the regulation of Administrative Measures for the Capital of Commercial Banks (for Trial Implementation).

Based on related guidance of Basle committee and regulations made by CBRC, the management of the Group monitors the adequacy of capital and the application of regulation capital in real time. The Bank reports required information about capital to CBRC once a quarter.

### XV Fair Value of Financial Instruments

Fair value refers to in the orderly transaction occurred in the measurement date, the price needs to be paid by the market participant for selling an asset or need to pay for transferring a liability. Whether the fair value is observable or is estimated by using the technique, the measuring /or disclosed fair value in this financial statement are all confirmed on this basis.

The fair value measurement of the financial assets and financial liabilities of the group the current year or previous year has not happened to happen between the first level and second level, and between the second level and third level.

When unable to get the quotation from the active market, the Group determines the fair g value of the financial assets and financial liabilities which continually makes the fair value measurement through the valuation technique.

Except the financial assets and financial liabilities of the above continuous proceeding fair value measurement, the Group does not hold any financial instruments of non-continuous fair value measurement.

## XVI Non-adjusting Events After the Balance Sheet Date

According to the suggestion of the board, the company may take 684,400 thousand yuan for the risk provision from the profit, and no dividend to investors this year. The suggestion will be approved by the board of shareholders, prepare the risk provision before the meeting.

Up to April 12,2016, there was no non-adjusting event after the balance sheet which was needed disclosure occurred in the bank and the group.

### XVII The Approval of Financial Statement

The financial statement was approved by the board of directors of the bank on April 12, 2016.
